title: Story premise ENT077: The Last Note on the Bench
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (silent emotional stories). Hook: The final note still belongs here. Takeaway/theme: A moment can matter even when its ending is quiet.
description: A busker wants to finish a melody, but the single listener leaves before the final note. The busker plays it anyway; a folded paper bird left on the bench opens to show the listener’s drawing of the performance, and the busker places it beside the case.
